chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yasar, from Ubaydullah al-Dahqan, from Durust, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When the riding animal stumbles beneath a man, and he says to it, 'May you be ruined,' it says, 'May the most disobedient of us to the Lord be ruined.'

key_terms.أعصانا للرب: The most disobedient of us to the Lord — the animal's response implying the curse should fall on the truly disobedient one
key_terms.الدابة: Riding/pack animal — any domesticated beast used for transport
key_terms.تعست: May you be ruined/perish — an Arabic curse expressing anger or ill-will

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about cursing your riding animal when it stumbles?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmitting a saying of the Prophet (SAWW) about the spiritual harm of cursing one's riding animal. According to the teaching, when a man curses his mount for stumbling, the animal miraculously responds by redirecting the curse toward whoever among them is most disobedient to God — implying the curse may fall back upon the man. The hadith teaches accountability in speech and warns against cursing animals for natural mishaps, as such language reflects one's own spiritual state.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Bin Yasaar, from Ubeydullah Al Dahqan, from Dorost, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When the animal stumbles beneath the man, so he (the man) says to it, ‘May you be ruined’. It (the animal) says, ‘May the one (who is) disobedient to the Lord<sup>azwj</sup> be ruined’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad ibn Yasar from ‘Ubayd Allah al-Dihqan from Durust who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
When a stumper stumbles and man riding it says, ‘May you be destroyed.’ The stumper says, ‘May the one of us who is most disobedient to the Lord be destroyed.’”
